sources.label: MicroG RE compatibility and filter visability patch for ArchiveTune
sources.author: ArchiveTune microG
patch_list: ArchiveTune's account switcher hides every account that YouTube reports as having no YouTube channel. Music-only brand accounts usually have none, so they never show up under "YouTube channels" in the account menu. This makes them show up.

Sign in with an account from microG (GmsCore) instead of typing a Google password. microG signs the login page in as the chosen account, then ArchiveTune's normal login flow runs, including YouTube Music's own main/brand account switcher.
